### 1. Scene
A partially filled plate with creamy dressed lettuce salad, broccoli, a small amount of rice, and mixed cooked vegetables. Some pale yellow salad pieces appear to be egg; the small golden cube may be potato.

### 2. Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using an equivalent circular diameter of **27 cm**, its area is approximately **572 cm²**.

### 3. Items
Lettuce, creamy dressing, likely egg pieces, broccoli, cooked rice, tomato and other cooked vegetables, and a small potato-like cube. No separate pool of oil is visible.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas below are apportioned without double-counting overlapping foods. Dressing coats the salad, so it adds no separate footprint.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Lettuce | 27% | 154 × 3 = 462 ml | 0.15 | 69 g | 15 | 10 kcal |
| Likely egg pieces | 4% | 23 × 1 = 23 ml | 0.95 | 22 g | 155 | 34 kcal |
| Creamy dressing | Coating | Estimated 20 ml coating | 1.0 | 20 g | 350 | 70 kcal |
| Broccoli, both portions | 10% | 57 × 2 = 114 ml | 0.6 | 69 g | 35 | 24 kcal |
| Cooked rice | 4% | 23 × 1 = 23 ml | 0.8 | 18 g | 130 | 23 kcal |
| Tomato and other cooked vegetables | 5% | 29 × 1.5 = 44 ml | 0.6 | 26 g | 55 | 14 kcal |
| Potato-like cube | 1% | 6 × 1.5 = 9 ml | 0.7 | 6 g | 100 | 6 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 27 + 4 + 10 + 4 + 5 + 1 = **51%**, consistent with the substantial empty space.

### 8. Sanity check
The estimate is **230 g and approximately 180 kcal**. This is plausible for a largely vegetable-based, half-covered plate with only a spoonful of rice. The dressing quantity and identification of the yellow pieces are the main uncertainties.
